causal_rag.name: causal_rag
causal_rag.title: Causal RAG: hypothesis and testing agents on the CauseTrace graph
causal_rag.description: A hypothesis agent proposes up to six signed cause-and-effect chains for the month; a testing agent (three seeds, majority vote) labels each Supported, Contradicted or Insufficient against the CauseTrace claims graph. Per fund the stated view is the signed count of Supported chains (F_S); F_C and F_I are features. For two funds IEF's signals stand in for TLT. Exploratory: run on a free stand-in model (qwen3:4b) whose reliability gates failed.
causal_rag.author: Claire, Farnoosh

committee.name: committee
committee.title: AI committee: economist, risk manager, CIO (GPT-4o)
committee.description: Three GPT-4o roles read the same masked month. The economist writes the macro read, the risk manager what could go wrong, and the CIO gives an expected one-month return per fund with a confidence word. The CIO's numbers are the stated view; the three texts are the trace.
committee.author: Farnoosh, Diwas

det.name: det
det.title: Deterministic model: 8 Bloomberg surprise z-scores
det.description: Stage 2's macro panel: standardised surprises (actual minus consensus) for NFP, retail sales, industrial production, ISM manufacturing, CPI, core CPI, PPI and average hourly earnings, known at the month-end decision. States no direction of its own; the shared learner (purged expanding Ridge) turns the features into a view.
det.author: Grace, Qianyi

jev.name: jev
jev.title: Jev: TypeSafe decision model, typed questions
jev.description: Jev answers typed questions about the masked month with probabilities. Two funds: P(stocks beat bonds), a 5-way tilt whose probability-weighted points (+3, +1.5, 0, -1.5, -3) are the stated view, and a confidence. Three funds: P(SPY beats IEF), P(LQD beats IEF), P(best fund) per fund; the stated view is P(best) - 1/3.
jev.author: Diwas

placebo.name: placebo
placebo.title: Placebo: no forecast, same machinery
placebo.description: Supplies no signal. The pipeline's view is the historical average (intercept only), so the placebo shows what tilting with no information costs. Every plugin is compared with it.
placebo.author: harness
